tool_args.prompt: Create a single complete full-body transparent-background visual of Whopper from Resident Evil 6 (2012), strictly the FINAL IN-GAME RENDER IN THE RIGHT HALF of the attached Capcom interview comparison. The LEFT HALF is a different painted concept and is NOT the design reference. Generate exactly one character, not the comparison layout. Preserve the extremely broad heavy body and protruding belly, small head, short dark hair, grey-pale skin, source face, red short-sleeved torn shirt with the broad faded yellow band, irregular torn lower hem, dark ripped trousers/shorts, and bare feet. Preserve the source's uneven fabric coverage and the large belly opening toward his anatomical RIGHT; do not move that tear to the left. Retain the tattered irregular leg hems rather than imposing matching new shorts. His anatomical RIGHT hand is raised in front of him at about head/shoulder height as in the final render; his anatomical LEFT arm stays lowered and slightly out with a loosely open hand. Maintain those anatomical sides when rotating. No shoes, gloves, new equipment, new wounds, bright concept-art red lighting or attack victim. Create a new physically rotated side-dominant three-quarter static pose facing SCREEN-RIGHT: face, chest, belly and feet point right. Its anatomical RIGHT side is nearest the viewer. The near RIGHT arm is raised; the far LEFT arm stays lower. The anatomical-right exposed belly tear stays on the near flank. Rotate the actual character; do not mirror a source or another output. Keep a believable planted or slight stepping stance with both feet fully inside. Match the attached original 2012 game character and material treatment; retain recognizable proportions and wear rather than redesigning it. Fit the entire single subject inside the canvas, including the highest projection, every finger and both feet, with at least TEN PERCENT completely transparent margin on every side of the combined silhouette. Scale down the whole subject together if necessary. True transparent RGBA background; no environment, floor, cast shadow on a floor, pedestal, haze, glow, border, text, watermark, logo, extra person or sprite sheet. This is one generated static visual candidate; unseen surfaces are inferred, not certified native geometry or an animation.
